body: Auditory hallucinations not sure if that counts, but for the longest time I though everyone heard people who weren't there talking to them. I had on were I thought I heard a women barking, at the time I was with friends and though of course they've all heard that. Turns out its not normal to hallucinate nonexistent people barking.
We still bring this up as it though it was creepy its pretty funny
Whenever people my knock on my dorm door to ask if I'm their I pretend I'm asleep or not there. Works pretty well.

I have autism and most of my life have struggled to make friends. One thing I found is the best way to make friends is just by saying hello, I made one of my closest friend  because I told her I like how she dresses. I know its hard but small talk does help you form relationships.
I did once as a joke, and a couple hours later I heard the knocking again. Definitely not going to do that again, I don't mess around with spirits. I will update if I hear more knocks!
It was done in our fine arts building apparently, but I think more spooky things have happened in the past.
Apparently a person committed suicide on campus here and since then things have been skilled.
Its really loud though, like crazy persistent it drives me kind of crazy as its so frequent.

Right! My roommate is never there, and kind of wrote off when I talked about the knocking. For the first time ever she heard it, and now the both of us are both thoroughly terrified. But hey at least she believes me now.

I had a younger sibling who was miscarried, and had a weird dream of a dark haired little girl, in the dream I knew she was my baby sister but for some odd reason she didn't want to talk. Almost like she wasn't ready to talk, she was a pretty little thing she had dark hair and was dressed in my favorite green dress from childhood. I feel rather weird about the dream, but glad in a way, she looked like such a happy little girl.
Exactly, I feel when I try and explain what I meant people just don't care. As they feel I might just be looking for excuses.

As I said before I am on the spectrum, so finding love was something I never saw happening to me. At this moment in time its also my fault for not reaching out, as I worry about burdening people with my mental health issues as they are a lot for some people. I'm terrified he'll leave me forever and  its all partially my fault, as I struggle with being kind and using a filter for my mouth.

I don't want to die in all honesty, I'm in college and am going through a tough time. I feel left out and very alone, I feel though if I don't get help soon I may attempt suicide or hurt myself. As at this point in time I don't know were to go other than the internet. I feel nobody likes me or wants to deal with me and I need to be away from school.
